tagline.en_US: With Downtify you can download Spotify musics containing album art, track names, album title and other metadata about the songs. Just copy the Spotify link, whether it's a single song, an album, etc. As soon as your downloads are complete you will be notified!

description.en_US: Downtify is a self-hosted music downloader and player that turns links from Spotify, YouTube Music, Deezer, and SoundCloud into a tagged audio library. It resolves metadata from public web pages without needing Spotify accounts or API keys, matching audio and fetching it via YouTube. The application includes a built-in web player with synchronized lyrics, playlist management, automated playlist monitoring, and multi-user support.

tips: Sign in using the default credentials admin / downtify
Change the default password in Settings → General after logging in
